description: This file provides helper routines for interacting with libxml2, including functions for reading and setting XML node contents and attributes, as well as creating and finding nodes.
external_methods: xmlNodePtr appendNewStringNode(xmlNodePtr, const char *, const char *)

methods.name: getXmlNodeContentsAsInt
methods.description: Reads the contents of an XML node and interprets it as an integer.

methods.name: getXmlNodeContentsAsUnsignedInt
methods.description: Reads the contents of an XML node and interprets it as an unsigned integer.

methods.name: getXmlNodeContentsAsUnsignedLongLong
methods.description: Reads the contents of an XML node and interprets it as an unsigned long long.

methods.name: getXmlNodeContentsAsBoolean
methods.description: Reads the contents of an XML node and interprets it as a boolean value.

methods.name: setXmlNodeContentsAsBoolean
methods.description: Sets the contents of an XML node as a boolean value.

methods.name: getXmlNodeContentsAsString
methods.description: Reads the contents of an XML node as a string.

methods.name: appendNewStringNode
methods.description: Creates a new XML node with specified name and contents, appends it to a parent node.

methods.name: findChildNode
methods.description: Finds a child node with a specific name within a base node.

methods.name: getXmlNodeAttributeAsInt
methods.description: Reads an attribute from an XML node and interprets it as an integer.

methods.name: setXmlNodeAttributeAsInt
methods.description: Sets an integer attribute on an XML node.

methods.name: getXmlNodeAttributeAsUnsignedInt
methods.description: Reads an attribute from an XML node and interprets it as an unsigned integer.

methods.name: getXmlNodeAttributeAsUnsignedLongLong
methods.description: Reads an attribute from an XML node and interprets it as an unsigned long long.

methods.name: getXmlNodeAttributeAsBoolean
methods.description: Reads an attribute from an XML node as a boolean value.

methods.name: setXmlNodeAttributeAsBoolean
methods.description: Sets a boolean attribute on an XML node.

methods.name: getXmlNodeAttributeAsString
methods.description: Reads an attribute from an XML node as a string.
